claims: No. 6 seed Alabama defeated No. 11 seed Rhode Island 68-55 in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament on March 21, 2026.
The win marked Alabama's third straight Round of 32 appearance.
Jessica Timmons scored 21 points and had 6 rebounds for Alabama.
Essence Cody scored 19 points for Alabama.
Essence Cody is a 6-foot-4 post for Alabama.
The game was at KFC Yum! Center in Louisville, Ky.
Palmire Mbu scored 11 points for Rhode Island.
Ines Debroise scored 11 points for Rhode Island.
Alabama dominated Rhode Island in the paint 42-12.
Alabama led throughout most of the first half.
Alabama used a 12-0 run in the third quarter to pull away.
Alabama advanced to face No. 3 Louisville in the second round.
Rhode Island ended their season at 28-5.
The game was Rhode Island's first NCAA appearance in 30 years.
Alabama limited Rhode Island to a 9-1 run at the end of the first half.
